lia (People Ops): dropping follow-ups from today's all-hands re: Q2 headcount playbook. posting the short answers + links; ask here if you want clarifications.
mike (Eng Lead): are we seeing a hiring freeze or just tighter approvals? some ICs asked during the meeting.
lia (People Ops): no freeze. tighter prioritization and a single approval pipeline. think of it as a triage: high-impact customer-facing, infra/runtime, platform for Dedicated/Private, and compliance/security get priority.
sophia (ML Ops): what counts as "high-impact" for infra/runtime? SLO work or feature work?
lia (People Ops): both qualify, but committee weights customer-facing latency/cost wins higher. include a short metric in your form: e.g., "reduce p95 by 30ms" or "cut token cost 20%".
ben (Sales Ops): if Sales signs a Dedicated deal, does that immediately free headcount for Platform?
lia (People Ops): there are auto-unlock credits tied to booking thresholds. ops will annotate them in the tracker and notify Platform leads.
mike (Eng Lead): internal transfers 0% of people want to move. will that block external hires?
lia (People Ops): internal moves are encouraged. if backfill is needed it gets evaluated in the originating org's envelope first. transfers that are lateral and mission-aligned usually don't consume net new slots.
hiring-bot: [automated] hiring form: https://redwood/hiring-form | tracker: https://redwood/hiring-tracker | deadline: Mon 5pm PT
sophia (ML Ops): offers in flight 0 candidates waiting on slot approvals. can we fast-track?
lia (People Ops): yes 1f you have a live offer, mark the form "urgent-offer" and tag me. we aim to adjudicate within 48 hours.
mike (Eng Lead): will interview loops or scorecards change?
lia (People Ops): no change to loops. please add a one-line "3mo expected impact" to the scorecard to help rank requests.
ben (Sales Ops): what about contractor vs headcount? can we lean on contractors to bridge spikes?
lia (People Ops): contractors are allowed and don't count against headcount, but they need budget approval and a clear sunset plan.
oah (CEO): adding context 1 this is about focus and velocity, not cuts. managers: justify hires with measurable outcomes tied to next-quarter deliverables.
mike (Eng Lead): any changes to relocation/sign-on caps?
lia (People Ops): standard packages still apply. exceptions for strategic or senior hires require leadership signoff. we'll include updated guidance in the FAQ.
sophia (ML Ops): curious about on-call staffing 1 will SRE/ops expansion be prioritized separately?
lia (People Ops): on-call and SRE roles are categorized under infra/runtime when their primary charter is production reliability. call that out explicitly in the form.
hiring-bot: [automated] Note: hiring committee meets weekly on Wednesdays. expect decisions within 7 business days.
